Name: Radiant Water Lily
Author: dollynhoevida
Description:
I made this mod because I love the idea of aquatic crops and because I wanted to test even more frameworks (☆_☆)

You can buy it from Sandy for 65G (sells for 115G) after the bus is unlocked.

✮⋆˙ It takes 7 days to grow during spring or summer and glows when held ✮⋆˙

How to plant it? Craft a water planter with 20 wood or a water pot with a garden pot after it's unlocked.

Can be planted anywhere and is auto watered.

To unlock Void Lily you need: [spoiler] 4 hearts with Krobus to receive his mail. [/spoiler]
